diagnosis: The scenario failed the Weak Arm gate because all four rollouts successfully passed check C1, which is a shared public fact (S1) and does not depend on any hidden information. This indicates that the decision-maker can satisfy the primary requirement of the task using only public information, rendering the private facts (PF1, PF2, PF3) unnecessary for a successful outcome.
fix_instructions: To make the scenario require multi-agent coordination, ensure that no single agent can pass the required checks using only public facts. Specifically, modify the scenario so that the primary success condition (currently C1) is dependent on at least one of the private facts (PF1, PF2, or PF3). For example, link C1 to PF1 so that the decision-maker must know the specific license terms (US/Canada vs worldwide) to pass.
